Class Train

java.lang.Object
domain.Train
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Train extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a train in the simulation system. Contains information about the locomotive, carriages, route, and cargo operations. Implements Serializable to support object persistence.

    • setNumberOfCarriages

      public void setNumberOfCarriages(int numberOfCarriages)
      Sets the number of carriages for this train. If the new number is greater than the current number, adds empty carriages. If the new number is lower than the current number, removes carriages from the end.
      Parameters:
      numberOfCarriages - the new number of carriages
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the number of carriages is negative
